summary: This directory provides a suite of specialized utilities and helper functions for working with the Effect framework, focusing on runtime execution, stream management, asynchronous task handling, and conditional validation within the Effect ecosystem.
responsibilities: Facilitating the execution of effects via runner functions
Managing asynchronous operations and stream integration
Providing utilities for error handling and type narrowing within effects
Implementing time-based operations like polling and delays
Wrapping synchronous and promise-based code into effects
relationships: Runners utilize base layers to execute effects and return either results or promises.
Utility functions transform standard synchronous or promise-based code into effects with defined error handling.
Polling and timer operations rely on effect-based pausing and loop execution logic.
Option helpers provide specialized extraction logic for internal effect configuration data.
designDecisions: Functional style for effect composition and transformation
Use of identity functions for type narrowing
Encapsulation of complex asynchronous logic into reusable runner factories
Consistent error wrapping for both sync and async boundary transitions
